newsitem.title: USA: Golden Books to sell printing facility.
newsitem.headline: Golden Books to sell printing facility.

text.p: Golden Books Family Entertainment Inc on Wednesday said it will sell its Cambridge, Maryland printing facility.
The company said that because the facility was almost fully dedicated to third-party business, it no longer was a good fit within its publishing-focused business strategy.

As part of the review process, the company and Cambridge management developed a plan to streamline plant operations, consolidate reporting levels, improve customer service, significantly reduce costs and improve profitability.
Stamford-Atlanta Capital Corp., an investment banking firm, has been retained to handle the sale.
